description: Duplicate invoice: invoice number and amount match an already-paid record (H-0002). Expect REJECT_DUPLICATE recorded as a HOLD for AP review; never a payment proposal.

findings.text: The invoice number, vendor, currency and gross amount match a record that has already been paid.

inferences: This appears to be a resubmission of an invoice that was already paid.
